Zircon.fact: Zircons from Jack Hills in the Narryer Gneiss terrane, Yilgarn craton, Western Australia, have yielded U–Pb ages up to 4.404 billion years, interpreted to be the age of crystallization, making them the oldest minerals so far dated on Earth.
